answer: PoA resists Sybil control by binding every identity to bonded collateral and applying quadratic slashing: when k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting claims, aggregate penalties scale as O(k^2), not linearly. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss across the correlated set, while asymmetric depreciation limits recovery, making identity replication uneconomic. A voyage across an oasis or river cannot conceal coordinated fraud.
